description: Consolidated ABA PayWay error/status code registry. sandboxVerified: true means the meaning was reproduced against the live sandbox; evidence points into docs/SANDBOX-FINDINGS.md. Regenerate with `npm run gen:error-registry`.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Wrong HMAC composition — check the field order for the CoF endpoint being called.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Wrong HMAC composition — check the field order for the CoF endpoint being called.

codes.title: Validation / binding failure
codes.hint: Laravel-style binding/validation layer rejected the request — inspect the errors{} field map on the thrown error.

codes.title: Token not found
codes.hint: The ctid/request_id does not reference a known account token — verify or re-link.

codes.title: Merchant ID not found
codes.hint: Merchant ID not found — verify the merchant credential (env/profile) for the target environment.

codes.title: Merchant not enabled for token flag
codes.hint: The merchant account is not enabled for this token_flag — contact PayWay to provision, or use a linking enum (CITI_FLEX|CITO_FLEX|CITO_FIX|CITR_FLEX).

codes.title: Invalid payment credential token
codes.hint: The payment credential token is invalid or expired — re-link via linkAccount/linkCard or renew via renewToken.

codes.title: Wrong Hash
codes.hint: HMAC signature mismatch — check API key, field ordering, base64 vs hex encoding.

codes.title: Transaction Not Closable
codes.hint: Transaction status does not allow close — sandbox-verified: closing an already PAID transaction answers 403 code 2 (SANDBOX-FINDINGS §21). Only OPEN/PENDING transactions can be closed.

codes.title: Invalid Data
codes.hint: Server-side binding/validation failed — see errors map in rawBody for per-field messages.

codes.title: Transaction Not Found
codes.hint: Close/cancel target does not exist — verify tran_id.

codes.title: tran_id not found
codes.hint: check-transaction found no transaction with this ID.

codes.title: Invalid Request Data
codes.hint: Missing or malformed field - check parameter types.

codes.title: merchant_id not found
codes.hint: Merchant identity rejected on this endpoint (sandbox-verified HTTP 403 on check-transaction) - check PAYWAY_MERCHANT_ID or the active profile.

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency (e.g. send USD to a USD account).

codes.title: Invalid Merchant
codes.hint: merchant_id not recognized in this environment.

codes.title: Invalid Amount
codes.hint: Amount format wrong — use formatAmount()/decimal rules for the currency.

codes.title: Invalid Currency
codes.hint: Currency must be 'USD' or 'KHR'.

codes.title: Expired Transaction
codes.hint: Transaction/token expired — create a new one or renew the token.

codes.title: Transaction Not Found
codes.hint: No transaction with this tran_id (may have been closed).

codes.title: Invalid Beneficiary Data
codes.hint: RSA-encrypted beneficiaries malformed — verify public key + account format.

codes.title: Invalid Merchant Profile
codes.hint: Merchant identity rejected (sandbox-verified HTTP 400 on exchange-rate with unknown merchant_id) — check PAYWAY_MERCHANT_ID or the active profile.

codes.title: Payout Whitelist
codes.hint: Payout account not whitelisted — call addBeneficiary() first.

codes.title: Invalid Request
codes.hint: Validation failed. For transaction-list dates use "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss".

codes.title: Lifetime Below Minimum
codes.hint: Checkout purchase lifetime must be >= 3 minutes (API takes minutes; max 43200 = 30 days; spec-documented).

codes.title: Payee / Merchant Data
codes.hint: Beneficiary payee unknown, or payment-link id invalid (detail).

codes.title: Parameter Invalid Format
codes.hint: Check datatypes — amounts are numbers in the SDK (the official docs declare strings; the gateway accepts numbers). Sandbox probes: malformed values answered PTL04 instead.

codes.title: Merchant Invalid Currency
codes.hint: Currency not enabled for the merchant profile. Sandbox probe: EUR answered PTL04 — PTL99 not yet reproduced on this profile.

codes.title: Invalid Payment Link
codes.hint: Invalid payment link — pass the opaque data.id returned by create, NOT merchant_ref_no, NOT the URL slug. Sandbox note (2026-09-06): a bogus id answered 96 instead.

codes.title: Payment Link Already Voided
codes.hint: The payment link is already voided — already in the desired terminal state, not a failure. Void is not idempotent (HTTP 403, SANDBOX-FINDINGS §23); a second void on the same link id always answers PTL188.

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency. Send USD to a USD account; KHR to a KHR account.

codes.title: Payout amount mismatch
codes.hint: Sum of beneficiary amounts must equal the payout (transaction complete) amount.

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency. Send USD to a USD account; KHR to a KHR account.

codes.title: Unable to complete pre-auth
codes.hint: Transaction status does not allow capture (never authorized, already completed/cancelled).

codes.title: Merchant information invalid
codes.hint: Sandbox profile lacks permission for this operation (e.g. complete-with-payout) — contact PayWay to provision.

codes.title: Unable to cancel pre-auth
codes.hint: Only OPEN/PENDING pre-auths can be cancelled — check current status first.

codes.title: QR request rejected (wrong hash or malformed request)
codes.hint: Check the 19-field HMAC order (req_time..payout) and the API key.

codes.title: QR gateway error code 6
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Rate limit exceeded
codes.hint: Pace requests — the SDK throttles locally, but concurrent callers share the window.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Check API key and HMAC field ordering.

codes.title: Parameter validation required
codes.hint: Amount must be ≥ $0.01 USD / ≥ 1 KHR; check other required fields.

codes.title: Transaction not found
codes.hint: Verify the original tran_id — refunds need a captured transaction.

codes.title: Refund exceeds original amount
codes.hint: Reduce the refund amount to fit the remaining refundable balance.

codes.title: Unable to refund
codes.hint: Transaction may not be refundable — check its status via transaction-detail.

codes.title: Refund failed
codes.hint: PayWay could not process the refund — contact PayWay support with the trace id.

codes.title: Concurrent request rejected
codes.hint: Another refund for this transaction is in flight — retry after it settles.

codes.title: Insufficient merchant balance
codes.hint: Top up the merchant account before retrying.
